::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 29 [after 1884?]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Winchester City Council, Historic Resources Centre LH3803.2
:::

Dear [Miss Atkinson](people/person_70.qmd),

I sent on your Robin and I think we are grateful for it

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Blanche Atkinson was an associate of Frances Power Cobbe and Ruskin and a keen naturalist who contributed to *MP* in 1893, but this letter may not be to her, and the 'Robin' cannot be identified.
